A0270.title: Rug Pull Loss Compensation and Fund Recovery
A0270.definition: Compensating victims or recovering funds after a Rug Pull through DeFi insurance claims, asset freezing and tracing, and recovery protocols.
A0270.description: After an incident is confirmed, responders use policy coverage terms, on-chain loss evidence, and governance decisions to initiate claims and compensate eligible policyholders. They also trace the movement of attack proceeds, coordinate with exchanges to freeze identifiable assets, and use cross-chain recovery protocols or governance mechanisms to return funds. This measure addresses the post-loss response stage and aims to reduce net losses rather than replace preventive audits or real-time alerts.
A0270.limitation: Insurance only covers the protocols, events, and limits explicitly listed in a policy, so uninsured users or claims without sufficient evidence may receive no compensation. Recovery also depends on asset traceability, exchange cooperation, and governance decisions. Success rates decline sharply once attackers use mixers, cross-chain bridges, or rapid cash-out channels.
keywords: Rug Pull Loss Compensation and Fund Recovery
